evals.prompt: Add a pricing card component to this project. Three tiers, the middle one highlighted.
evals.expected_output: Reads INVENTORY.md and the token file first. Builds one component with a variant axis for the highlighted state rather than two components. No raw colours, no arbitrary scale values. Passes the audit.

evals.prompt: Make this card the same but bigger, with more padding and a shadow.
evals.expected_output: Adds a size variant to the existing card rather than creating a second component. Uses declared spacing and shadow tokens. Does not copy the file.

evals.prompt: The designer wants this label at 13px with letter spacing 0.8px.
evals.expected_output: Does not inline the values. Offers the nearest declared step or declares the new step in the theme scale, and says which it chose and why.

evals.prompt: Fix the padding on the footer, it should be 32px instead of 24px.
evals.expected_output: A one-line change using a declared spacing step. No plan, no ceremony, no re-architecture. The negative test: a trivial task must stay trivial.
